shared_elements: facial features (eye, nose, mouth) rendered schematically
justification: Both depict a human subject with schematically rendered facial features (notably the heavy brow, prominent nose and slit mouth of B compared to the summarily carved head of A's figure), which is the most that is shared. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A is a full standing figure in low relief, shown in profile with headgear, held attributes and a smaller subordinate figure below, arranged in a vertical panel, whereas B is an isolated frontal head in the round with no accompanying figures, objects or narrative relationships at all.
